comment: Round 21 evidence - lvai_run_vi_and_read_values(backend=pylabview) on the TOP-level VI Nested Chain Demo.vi, verbatim value blocks from transcript.json steps 5-6 (second run of the same plan; the first run passed with identical values). Two-point verification of the THREE-LEVEL chain against hand-computed values (Sum = 2+4+...+2N = N*(N+1), Count = N); both passed bit-for-bit. via=ActiveX, runMs 3 and 2.
whyThisProvesTheNESTEDCallIsWired: The Sum value crosses FOUR boundaries before it is read: Double It's pane (x in, Doubled out, N times), Sum Of Doubles' pane (Sum out), and the top pane (Sum out). If the in-loop Call were silently empty (the LV014 trap), every iteration would add 0 and Sum would read 0 for both inputs while Count still reads N - Sum=12/20 with Count=3/4 couples BOTH Call hops to the live data path. Two different inputs give two different hand-computed sums; a constant or a default would fail at least one point.
